stories.title: S&P 500 sales growth hits a nearly 5-year high as investors size up the week ahead
stories.summary: S&P 500 companies are posting sales growth at its strongest pace in almost five years, according to MarketWatch. A companion CNBC piece frames the week ahead around two key things traders are watching in the stock market, though the specific catalysts weren't detailed beyond that framing.
stories.whyItMatters: Broadening top-line growth across the index is a different story than earnings beats driven by cost-cutting, and it shapes how investors judge whether the market's gains are backed by real demand.
whatToWatch: Whether sales-growth strength shows up broadly across sectors or stays concentrated in a few names
The two catalysts CNBC flagged for the week ahead as they become clearer
questions: Is the sales-growth surge concentrated in a handful of mega-cap names or broad-based?

stories.title: Stocks beating the S&P 500 hit a 4-year high — MarketWatch says that number could keep climbing
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports the share of individual stocks outperforming the S&P 500 index is at its highest level in four years. The piece argues that market breadth — participation beyond the index's biggest names — has room to widen further.
stories.whyItMatters: Wider breadth is generally read as a healthier, less concentrated rally, which matters to anyone worried the market's gains have been riding on a small handful of mega-cap stocks.
whatToWatch: Whether breadth continues improving or reverts back toward mega-cap concentration
questions: What's driving the shift — sector rotation, earnings, or falling rates?

stories.title: Dow futures hold steady as market bulls stay in control; Cisco, Lumentum earnings loom
stories.summary: Dow Jones futures are pointing to continued control by market bulls, per Yahoo Finance, as investors look ahead to earnings from Cisco and Lumentum. The report frames the broader tape as still favoring buyers heading into these reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Cisco is a bellwether for enterprise tech spending and networking demand, while Lumentum's results speak to optical and datacenter/AI infrastructure demand — both are read as signals for the broader tech trade.
whatToWatch: Whether the bullish futures setup holds through the trading session
questions: Will Cisco and Lumentum confirm continued strength in enterprise and AI-infrastructure spending?
